newsitem.title: UK: Salomon Bros picks steel stocks seen moving ahead.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Bros picks steel stocks seen moving ahead.

text.p: Salomon Brothers kicked off coverage of the European steel industry predicting certain stocks including British Steel Plc will move ahead as earnings and cash flow improve.

Terence Sinclair, European steel analyst said in his report "UK and European steel - in search of safe passage" that he rated British Steel, Usinor-Sacilor and Krupp as medium-term buy recommendations "based on the superior value of their restructuring initiatives, growth potential, operating efficiencies and value on fundamentals against other steelmakers."
He said in a statement "At the moment steel stocks reflect a discount appropriate for previous cycles when even the strongest performers reported losses in trough years.
"Now, a more favourable trading environment means 1996 will be a short downturn and stocks could reflect stronger operating cash flows across the cycle."
Sinclair has rated Thyssen, Hoogovens and Arbed as holds.
